commons_claim: Drel hunts Cassik when temperature is at most 17°C AND drel_density is below 60; otherwise it does not hunt.
evidence_summary: All six confirmed observations fit this rule exactly: hunted cases have temperatures ≤17 and densities <60, while non-hunted cases violate at least one condition.
